## 2. Technical Capabilities & Technology Stack

Discover Crew Technologies utilizes modern, industry-standard development frameworks and architectural patterns:

- **Frontend & Full-Stack**: Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, Responsive & Mobile-First UI/UX.
- **Backend & Cloud Architecture**: Node.js, Python, RESTful API Engineering, GraphQL, Serverless Functions, Edge Middleware.
- **Databases & State Management**: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Supabase, Firebase.
- **AI & Automation**: OpenAI API, Google Gemini API, Anthropic Claude, LangChain, LlamaIndex, automated webhook architectures, Vector Databases.
- **DevOps, Hosting & CI/CD**: Vercel Edge Network, GitHub Actions, Docker, Cloudflare DNS & SSL.
